exports.gladiaSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createGladiaSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, totalTimeoutMs, callTimeoutMs, pollCallTimeoutMs, pollWindowMs, pollIntervalMs, maxResultBytes, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildGladiaTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { upload: FormData, model, responseFormat } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.gladiaJobBody: (audioUrl, model) -> source submit body { audio_url, model }
exports.gladiaAudioUrl: (uploadAnswer) -> audio_url when it is a plain https URL, else null
exports.gladiaResultJob: (submitAnswer) -> { jobId, pollUrl } when result_url is exactly https://api.gladia.io/v2/pre-recorded/<id>, else null
exports.gladiaAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState, jobId) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.GLADIA_PROVIDER_DEFINITION: staged registry entry (id, alias, display, apikey auth, transport, serviceKinds, sttConfig)
exports.GLADIA_DROPPED_FIELDS: request fields the source ignores; refused when set
